newsitem.title: USA: Mild temps continue for Brazil coffee belt - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Mild temps continue for Brazil coffee belt - WSC.

text.p: Warm, high pressure is expected to remain in Brazil's coffee belt through the first half of next week, Weather Services Corp said in an update on Thursday.
According to WSC, colder air building into Argentina will pass to the south of the coffee belt over the weekend as the high pressure system continues to dominate the area.
Fair to partly cloudy skies were observed in the region this morning. Low temperatures ranged from 52-63 F (11-17 C).

Increasing clouds may develop in the region today. Mostly cloudy skies with scattered showers and thunderstorms are expected for Friday and Saturday. Low temperatures are expected to range from the 50's to middle 60's (teens C).

The extended outlook calls for partly cloudy skies and a few light showers in the southern region of the belt for the early part of next week. Temperatures are expected to remain near to above normal with no damaging cold, according to WSC.
